test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some pupils are cutes.

All boys are cutes.

**Conclusions:**

I. All cutes are boys.

II. Some pupils are boys.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Given Statements:

Some pupils are cutes.

All boys are cutes.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9223739d97b5a5f446a258dbd923c453d3a09126cc29778eb1cd02bf7c180b3.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All cutes are boys - False (Because, All boys are cutes gives some cutes are definitely boys, but All cutes are boys can be possible only).

II. Some pupils are boys - False (Because, No definite relation given between pupils and boys, so it can be possible only).

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follow. 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
